name: engineering-agent-skills
description: Source-first project context with native Grill local-Markdown reuse and living architecture/overview synchronization; optional multi-/single-Git verification and release.

interface.shortDescription: Local Markdown decision reuse and living engineering docs
interface.longDescription: project-context enters new or existing codebases, reuses upstream Grill/Wayfinder's configured Local Markdown Maps/specs, ADRs and glossary without forcing a duplicate docs index; adds update-design to maintain current system architecture and high-level design against source evidence and confirmed decisions. The Agent directly executes product work and synchronizes affected docs. engineering-governance offers optional integrated verification and reproducible releases for single- or multi-Git products.
defaultPrompt: Use project-context to enter this new or existing engineering project. Prefer current source evidence and configured upstream local Markdown tracker/domain guidance, not a duplicate document index.

Use project-context update-design to inspect current source and confirmed decisions, then update the actual system architecture and high-level design documents without overwriting approved requirements.
Use upstream Grill/Wayfinder and optional to-spec for important decisions in configured Local Markdown. Let the Agent execute the approved scope directly and sync affected long-lived docs.
Use project-context add-rule only for an approved, evidenced project rule; maintain rule files inside .agents/rules/ without editing AGENTS.md per rule.
Use engineering-governance verify or release only for warranted integration and reproducible delivery.
